note: Round two (Sky picked Qwen3-TTS VoiceDesign). Each person is designed once, on a neutral reference sentence that is never in the game, then every line is cloned from that reference with the Base model, so the voice holds. Bands are the median pitch a calm reading should fall in (Hz).
ref_text: I've walked this square every day for years, and I know most of the doors, and most of the faces that come through them.

larthi.describe: Female, about 25 years old, low alto, quiet and dry, clipped and watchful, speaks evenly and briefly; neutral unplaceable accent.

hasti.describe: Female, early thirties, warm mezzo-soprano, unhurried and reassuring, kind, measured pace; neutral accent.

sethre.describe: Male, about 30 years old, calm baritone with a low, relaxed pitch, patient and quietly amused, even pace; neutral accent.

arruns.describe: Male, about 60 years old, a big man with a deep bass voice, slow, calm and economical, heavy and grounded.

popovic.describe: Male, early sixties, a city councillor, dry precise baritone, clipped consonants, used to being obeyed; faint Central European colouring.

arthur.describe: Male, about 40 years old, a door guard, warm working-class baritone, plain and friendly, a little tired; soft city accent.

lukac.describe: Male, mid forties, a chauffeur, laconic low baritone, wry and weary; faint Central European colouring.

inez.describe: Female, mid twenties, a waitress, bright quick soprano, nervous and defensive, words tumbling out, warm underneath.

milena.describe: Female, late thirties, dry teasing alto, fond and knowing, unhurried, gently mocking a friend.

police.describe: Male, mid thirties, a uniformed police officer, strong commanding baritone, sharp and authoritative.

rival.describe: Male, mid thirties, a rough hard man with a low gravelly baritone, blunt and urgent.

watcher.describe: Male, fifties, a security desk clerk, flat bureaucratic baritone, precise, turning urgent.

shout_ref_text: Hey! You there! Stop, and keep your hands where I can see them!

m1.describe: Female, about 25 years old, a cafe waitress, bright clear mezzo-soprano, quick lively pace, a grin in her voice, playful and teasing, lots of pitch movement; neutral accent.

m2.describe: Female, about 25 years old, a cafe waitress from Sweden, light Swedish accent with a gentle sing-song lilt, rising and falling melody, cheerful, dry and teasing, relaxed pace.

m3.describe: Female, early forties, an older waitress, low husky smoky voice with a little gravel, slow and unhurried, dry warmth, wry and fond, like a big sister.

robot.describe: A calm, polite public-address announcer voice, mid pitch, perfectly even and precise, no emotion, measured pace with each word evenly spaced, courteous and unhurried.

a1.label: London
a1.describe: Female, about 25, a London cafe waitress, working-class London accent, quick dry wit, teasing, chirpy but low-key.

a2.label: Irish
a2.describe: Female, about 27, soft Irish accent from Dublin, warm teasing lilt, easy and fond, unhurried.

a3.label: Scottish
a3.describe: Female, about 26, Glasgow Scottish accent, sharp dry humour, brisk, warm underneath.

a4.label: American
a4.describe: Female, about 24, an American diner waitress from New York, fast deadpan wisecracks, bright and a little nasal.

a5.label: Eastern European
a5.describe: Female, about 28, light Polish accent in English, low calm voice, dry deadpan humour, fond, slightly formal English.

l1.label: Bright and quick
l1.describe: Female, early twenties, energetic and chatty, quick bright clear mezzo-soprano, warm and smiling, eager, crisp clear diction.

l2.label: Husky and lively
l2.describe: Female, mid twenties, a low husky raspy alto voice, but lively and talkative, quick and warm, grinning, very clear articulation.

l3.label: Cheeky and quick
l3.describe: Female, about 22, upbeat and talkative, rapid and friendly, a little cheeky, light Mediterranean colouring in her English, clear.

l4.label: Italian lilt
l4.describe: Female, early twenties, a light Italian accent, energetic and chatty, warm, quick musical speech with lots of melody, clear diction, a slightly lower voice.
